slides.title: Sudan again points at Ethiopia over drones
people killed in Khartoum strikes
slides.body: Drones hit the Khartoum area early Sunday, Nov 22, including a child south of the capital, Al Jazeera reported.

slides.title: UN building hit with staff inside
slides.body: UN humanitarian coordinator Denise Brown said a UN building was damaged. OCHA called the risk to staff "unacceptable."

slides.title: Sudan's claim: launched from Bahir Dar
slides.body: A Sudanese army source told AFP the drones came from Bahir Dar airport in Ethiopia. This has not been independently verified.

slides.title: Ethiopia denies such claims
slides.body: Ethiopia has previously denied letting its territory be used for attacks on Sudan. No new response was reported (Addis Standard).

slides.title: UN and US urge a halt to drone flows
slides.body: Brown and US adviser Massad Boulos called for stopping drone supplies and a humanitarian truce.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate independently.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Al Jazeera/AFP, Nov 22; Addis Standard, Nov 23, 2026
